content_feed.headline: SEL Manufacturing Company Appoints New Chairperson and Directors
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Board changes include the appointment of a new Independent Director as Chairperson.
content_feed.telegram_post: 👤 #APPOINTMENT | SEL Manufacturing Company Limited (NSE: SELMC) Board Restructuring: New Chairperson and Directors Appointed ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Chairperson Appointed: Mrs. Rajdeep Jagotra (Independent Director) - Additional Independent Director: Mr. Iqbal Singh - Additional Non-Executive Director: Mr. Ajab Singh - Effective Date: 14th November, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The board approved the appointment of Mrs. Rajdeep Jagotra as an Additional Independent Director and Chairperson of the company, along with the appointments of Mr. Iqbal Singh and Mr. Ajab Singh to the board. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Jamna Auto Industries declares interim dividend of Rs. 1.00 per share
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company declared interim dividend along with record date and approved financial results.
content_feed.telegram_post: 💵 #DIVIDEND | Jamna Auto Industries Limited (NSE: JAMNAAUTO) Jamna Auto Industries declares interim dividend of Rs. 1.00 per share ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Dividend Amount: Rs. 1.00 per equity share - Face Value: Rs. 1.00 each - Financial Year: 2026-27 - Record Date: November 20, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The Board of Directors approved the un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and declared an interim dividend. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
